name: Joovy Twin Roo+ Car Seat Adapter – Maxi-Cosi/Cybex
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / Cybex footprint — the Clek Liing uses this footprint and is confirmed Liing-compatible on Clek's official stroller list.

install.pieces: car-seat adapter for the Twin Roo+ frame
install.notes: Clicks onto the Twin Roo+ frame to mount a Maxi-Cosi-footprint infant seat (e.g. Clek Liing). Joovy sells other Twin Roo+ adapters for Graco SnugRide Click Connect, Chicco, etc. — this Maxi-Cosi/Cybex variant is the one that fits the Liing.

notes: The Joovy Twin Roo+ is a frame for two infant car seats and needs brand-specific adapters (sold separately). Clek lists the Twin Roo+ under 'Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna'; the matching Joovy part is the Twin Roo+ Maxi-Cosi/Cybex Car Seat Adapter (SKU 9034, $44.90), which carries the Clek Liing. No printed Clek part number, so partNumber is null. Product page describes it as fitting 'Maxi Cosi/Cybex' seats.
